title: Direct images to the point of bounded constructible complexes are bounded constructible
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] $p,a,q,k_0,k$, a prime $\ell\neq p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ contained in $\Qlb$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi_E$ and $n\geq1$; put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and let $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb\}$. Let $Y$ be a separated finite-type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] $k$-scheme with structure morphism $a_Y:Y\to s=\Spec k$. Let $D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$ and $D^b_c(s,\Lambda)$ be the bounded constructible categories: finite-torsion constructibility [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] for $\Lambda=A_{E,n}$, the derived-complete integral category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] for $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$, the rationalized category [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] for $\Lambda=E$ and the common-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] for $\Lambda=\Qlb$. Let $Ra_{Y*}$ be the derived direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image] and $Ra_{Y!}$ the compact-support direct image: at finite level the compactification-independent functor [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], which is defined on $D^b_c(Y,A_{E,n})$ because every bounded constructible complex on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is of etale origin [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin], and for $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb$ the integral, rational and algebraically closed functors [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Then for every $K\in D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$,

$$
 Ra_{Y*}K\in D^b_c(s,\Lambda)\qquad\text{and}\qquad Ra_{Y!}K\in D^b_c(s,\Lambda).
$$

In particular both lie in the domain of the equivalence $\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,\Lambda)\xrightarrow{\sim}D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A_{E,n}),D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}(\mathcal O_E),D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(E),D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}(\Qlb)$ of the finite coefficient categories over a point [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point].

source.place: node def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology, order 1510: '$\RGamma(Y,K)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{Y*}K)$, $\RGammac(Y,K)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{Y!}K)$' (for $\operatorname{Fib}_s$, defined on $D^b_c(s,\Lambda)$, to apply, the direct images must be bounded constructible; the blueprint does not say so). Finite-level ingredients already in the DAG: thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility and sbc-thm-finiteness-finite-type for $Ra_{Y*}$ (on the etale-site categories), prop-finite-compact-support-constructibility for $Ra_{Y!,n}$
